lines: Your shelter. Small but solid — a cot, a workbench, and a desk. The walls are thick enough to muffle the wind.
A writing desk sits against the west wall. An empty ceramic pot rests on a shelf to the east.
— PERSONAL LOG —
You flip through the pages. Notes from your journey so far:
Arrived at Outpost Balor. Received weapon and Sol Unit. Cleared the occupied wing of luddite forces.
Traversed the dark perimeter. Encountered shade stalkers, nest mothers, and the remnants of old relay stations.
Reached Meridian City via the rail line. Secured a homestead on the East Terrace.
Current objective: Craft a rechargeable battery. Need Umbracite, Copper Coils, and Stabilizing Resin.
— PERSONAL LOG —
Crafted first rechargeable battery at Yun's workshop. Self-sufficient power — no longer dependent on Array energy supply.
The homestead garden is producing stabilizing resin. The terrace community has been welcoming.
Multiple contacts have asked me to return to the dark perimeter: biological samples for Councillor Denn, survey markers for Archivist Solen, a letter for Warden Holt.
Something is stirring on the Nightside. The planet remembers.

actions.text: An empty ceramic pot on a shelf. The soil inside is dark and damp. It feels like something should be growing here.

actions.prompt: The Umbral Seed pulses faintly in your pack. This pot's dark soil looks like it could be a good home for it.

options.label: Plant the Seed
options.description: Place the Umbral Seed in the pot.

lines: You press the Umbral Seed into the dark soil. For a moment, the bioluminescent pulse brightens — then fades to a faint glow.
The seed sits inert in its pot. Sable said it needs darkness to grow. Real darkness — not just shade.
'When you go back out there, bring it with you for a night. Then replant it.'

actions.text: The Umbral Seed sits in its pot, barely glowing. It needs exposure to the deep dark — a night on the Nightside — to truly grow. Sable might know more.

lines: The seed has changed. Tendrils of deep violet have erupted from the soil, climbing the shelf and reaching toward the ceiling.
A Gloomvine. Pulsing with a warm, steady bioluminescence — the heartbeat of the Nightside, growing in your homestead.
Small droplets of dark liquid bead along the vine's leaves. Umbral Extract — the substance Sable spoke of. Liquid memory.
The vine seems to respond to your presence, its glow brightening as you approach. It remembers the darkness you carried it through.

actions.text: The Gloomvine pulses gently as you collect another vial of Umbral Extract. The vine is endlessly productive — fed by something deep beneath the surface.

lines: — PERSONAL LOG —
Returned to the deep perimeter. Found the signal cave, the ravine, the old survey point. The planet is alive in ways no one expected.
Made contact with something at the Underlumen Approach. A resonance. The planet... hums. It remembers.
The Gloomvine grows. Daley's signal is resolved. Fen's squad found their peace. Solen and Asha have their data.
Whatever comes next — the Underlumen, the Array's response, the thing that's waking — I'll face it. I'm not alone anymore.
